description: Wind direction indicates the direction from which the wind is blowing, typically expressed in degrees from true north (0-360°) or as compass directions. Over the ocean, wind direction is crucial for understanding atmospheric circulation patterns, storm tracks, and the vector components of momentum transfer to the ocean surface. In the Antarctic region, wind direction determines the transport of sea ice, influences polynya formation and location, and affects the cross-frontal transport of water masses in the Southern Ocean.
title: Wind Direction
